Dear Helium D. Affiliate Support Team,

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to kindly ask whether you would consider supporting Payoneer as an
alternative payment method for affiliate commissions.

Unfortunately, my PayPal account is currently blocked, which makes it difficult
for me to receive payments through PayPal. As an affiliate marketer based in
Nigeria, having access to an alternative international payment method such as
Payoneer would be very helpful.

I am committed to promoting Helium D. products professionally and
ethically through my website, (contact hidden), and my social media
channels. I would be grateful if you could consider my request or let me know
whether there are any alternative payment options currently available for
affiliates in Nigeria.

I understand that payment methods may depend on your company's policies and
payment processing arrangements. I would sincerely appreciate any assistance or
consideration you can offer.

Thank you for your time and understanding. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Aremo M.
(contact hidden)

--

Hi Aremo,

Thanks for explaining the situation clearly, and sorry to hear your PayPal account is blocked.

Affiliate payouts are handled outside the store side, so which methods we can pay out on isn't mine to decide. I've passed your request to a colleague on our team, with your site, your location in Nigeria and the reason PayPal no longer works for you, so they can tell you whether Payoneer or another international option is possible for affiliates there.

The team is offline over the weekend and picks this up Monday at 10am Eastern. You'll get their answer as a reply to this email, so there's nothing further you need to send in the meantime.

Thanks for promoting HeliumDeploy, and for your patience.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Sarah,

Thank you for your kind response and for forwarding my request to the
appropriate team.

I sincerely appreciate your understanding and your willingness to help explore
alternative payment options for affiliates in Nigeria.

I will patiently await the team's response on Monday. I look forward to hearing
whether Payoneer or another suitable international payment method can be
supported.

Thank you again for your time and assistance.

Warm regards,
Aremo M.
KingdomAffiliateOffers

--

Hi Aremo,

Thank you, and no problem at all. It's with the team now and they'll come back to you here on Monday.

Thanks again for promoting HeliumDeploy, and have a good weekend.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Sarah and HeliumDeploy Team,

I hope you are doing well.

I am writing to kindly follow up on my request regarding an alternative payment
method for receiving my affiliate commissions.

As mentioned in my previous email, my PayPal account is currently blocked, and I
would be grateful if HeliumDeploy could consider Payoneer or another suitable
international payment option for affiliates based in Nigeria.

I understand that payment methods depend on your team's policies and payment
processing arrangements. I would sincerely appreciate an update on whether an
alternative payment method can be supported for my affiliate account.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I appreciate your assistance and look
forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Aremo M.

Thanks for following up, and sorry you didn't hear back today. Your request is still open with the team and has not been closed or missed.

They're offline for the evening and back tomorrow from 10am Eastern, and their reply will come to you right here in this thread.

Thank you for your patience, Aremo.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
